notablePrerequisites: Harabaz Druid does not have summoning sickness. You control at least five Allies.
description:
Activate Harabaz Druid by tapping it, adding at least five mana of any color.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Harabaz Druid.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
